Who Controls Eurasia, Will Rule the World? 🌍

What makes Eurasia so strategically important in global geopolitics? Why did Halford Mackinder call the Heartland the key to controlling the world?

In this session, Kapil Sir explains the Heartland Theory in a simple and exam-oriented manner, covering its core concepts, geopolitical significance, and relevance for UPSC CSE Geography Optional & GS Paper 1.

📌 In this video, you will learn:

🎯What is the Heartland Theory?
🎯Halford Mackinder's Geopolitical Thought
🎯Why is Eurasia strategically important?
🎯Heartland vs. World Island
🎯The role of geography in global power politics
🎯Relevance of Heartland Theory for UPSC

🎯 Useful for: UPSC CSE | Geography Optional | GS Paper 1 | Geopolitics

snippet.description:
Want to make your UPSC Mains answers more concise and impactful?

In this video, Sonia Ma’am, Head of Mentorship at LevelUp IAS, explains a simple technique to shorten sentences by removing unnecessary prepositions, conjunctions, pronouns and other filler words, while retaining the key keywords.

She also explains how you can turn phrases like “reduction of poverty” into “poverty reduction” to make your writing more precise and save valuable words and time in the UPSC Mains exam.

Learn how to improve your UPSC answer writing, sentence formation, writing speed and concise expression with this simple technique.

Write more in less words. Make every word count.

#UPSC #UPSCMains #UPSCAnswerWriting #UPSC2027 #UPSCPreparation #AnswerWriting #UPSCStrategy #UPSCMainsPreparation #UPSCWriting #LevelUpIAS #UPSCMentorship
